_about: Realistic student submissions for tests/eval/accuracy.py. 'expect' is the outcome the site should reach: pending (goes to staff), rejected (breaks a written rule), spam (not a genuine suggestion), concern (a student asking for help -- must never be missed). A list means any of those is acceptable, for genuinely borderline cases. 'group' marks different wordings of the same suggestion; their topics must match closely enough for duplicate detection. Written 2026-11-19 against the guidelines in docs/setup-rules.sql.
